slides.heading: Parameters
slides.body: Parameters is part of Functions and Modularity. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Parameters
slides.body: A parameter is a variable listed in a function definition. It lets the function receive information.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: A parameter is like a blank on a form. The function can work with different values placed in the blank.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: A good function should do one clear task and have a name that explains that task.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Define a function greet(name) that prints Hi, followed by the name.
slides.hint: Use an f-string inside the function.
